subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported model/provider override contract, and should that contract be `payload.model`, top-level job fields, or a dedicated override block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public cron schema, provider/model precedence, session-state isolation, docs, and upgrade behavior, so automation should not choose the API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend systemEvent payload overrides
options.body: Add `payload.model` or a provider/model ref to `systemEvent` cron payloads with run-scoped application, explicit validation, docs, and wake-now plus next-heartbeat tests.

options.title: Add job-level override fields
options.body: Introduce top-level cron `model` and `provider` fields that apply across payload kinds, accepting a broader schema and UI/CLI migration surface.

options.title: Keep systemEvent text-only
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` cron jobs as the supported model-selectable path and leave main-session system events tied to the target session's existing model state.

recommendation.title: Extend systemEvent payload overrides
recommendation.body: Add `payload.model` or a provider/model ref to `systemEvent` cron payloads with run-scoped application, explicit validation, docs, and wake-now plus next-heartbeat tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron session-target and model-routing history makes this the strongest available owner for the product/API contract choice.
